label: Mean Annual Total Precipitation (mm)
description: Zonal mean of gridded mean annual total precipitation (PRCPTOT), mm/year, per block.
dataQualityNote: Derived from a gridded raster (GeoTIFF), not a block-level vector file — value is the zonal mean of raster pixels whose center falls within the block polygon. A small number of blocks may fall back to the nearest valid pixel to the block centroid where the source grid is coarser than the block geometry.
